json.name: Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan
json.background_quote: He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from University of Delhi and is an Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Mr. Rangan was an Executive Director & Chief Financial Officer of HDFC Limited prior to its amalgamation with the Bank w.e.f. July 1, 2023 and is an expert in finance, accountancy, audit, economics, corporate governance, legal & regulatory compliance, risk management and strategic thinking.
